# CopyAudioScene <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Audio](BlitzBasic-Audio)

</div>


```blitzbasic
CopyAudioScene:Int32 scene:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scene` | In | Int32 | required | A scene from [CreateAudioScene](CreateAudioScene). Anything else is a runtime error. |

**Returns:** The handle of the new scene.

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Makes a new audio scene that holds the same values as another one, to make a variant of it. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
quiet = CopyAudioScene(space)
AudioSceneVolume quiet, world, 0.1
```
